meta.methodology: Read all 6 eitza edges for Torah #112. Collected assigned nodes from torah_112_packages.json (Package 1: דרך, זווג). Identified all 12 unique node IDs across the 6 cause/effect edges. None overlap with the 2 already-assigned nodes. Assigned each of the 12 unassigned nodes to the appropriate package by essential nature, consulting the source text (torah_112.txt) and the gap analysis (torah_112_additions.json) for context. All 12 nodes belong to the domain of truth (אמת) and divine light (אור ה') — the central thematic axis of Torah #112.

assignments.reason: This node refers to 'this advice' — the Torah's overarching eitza of pursuing truth. Its essential nature is the practice/counsel of truth. The Rebbe says that through this eitza one can be a truly righteous person all one's days, because truth is the light of God Himself which no darkness can obscure. The node's identity is bound to the domain of truth (אמת).

assignments.node_id: איש כשר באמת כל ימי חייו
assignments.node_text: אִישׁ כָּשֵׁר בֶּאֱמֶת כָּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו
assignments.reason: A truly righteous person throughout all his days — this is the ultimate fruit of the truth-path. Its essential nature is the state of abiding in truth (the qualifier 'באמת' is explicit). The person's righteousness is not separate from truth; it IS truth lived over a lifetime. Belongs in the truth/divine-light domain.

Speaking words of truth before God. Though the act is speech and the setting is prayer, the essential nature of this node is truth — the modifier 'אמת' is the defining quality. The speech is the vehicle; truth is the substance. The Torah's argument is that this truthful quality in speech is what triggers divine illumination. The node belongs with truth/divine-light, not with the speech-mechanics package (B) or the prayer-structure package (D).

assignments.node_id: דבורים מאירים, וה אור לו כנ"ל. ואזי: "פתח דבריך יאיר מבין פתיים" (תהלים קי"ט). כי הדבורים המאירים, הינו דבורי אמת כנ"ל, הם מראין לו הפתח
assignments.node_text: הַדִּבּוּרִים מְאִירִים, וַה' אוֹר לוֹ כַּנַּ"ל. וַאֲזַי: "פֵּתַח דְּבָרֶיךָ יָאִיר מֵבִין פְּתָיִים" (תְּהִלִּים קי"ט). כִּי הַדִּבּוּרִים הַמְּאִירִים, הַיְנוּ דִּבּוּרֵי אֱמֶת כַּנַּ"ל, הֵם מַרְאִין לוֹ הַפֶּתַח
assignments.reason: Illuminating words that show the opening — the Rebbe explicitly glosses 'הדבורים המאירים הינו דבורי אמת' (the illuminating words, that is, words of truth). The illumination is the essential quality, and the Rebbe equates it directly with truth. The verse 'פתח דבריך יאיר' (the opening of Your words illuminates) seals the identification: truth-words = light = seeing the opening. This is squarely in the truth/divine-light domain.

The truest truth — the highest grade of truth. This is the superlative form of the Torah's central concept. One who attains this level has God as his own light and illuminates from within himself (מאיר בעצמו). This is the pinnacle of Package A's domain.

assignments.node_id: ה אור לו, ואזי הוא מאיר בעצמו, כי נתלבש בו אור ה
assignments.node_text: ה' אוֹר לוֹ, וַאֲזַי הוּא מֵאִיר בְּעַצְמוֹ, כִּי נִתְלַבֵּשׁ בּוֹ אוֹר ה'
assignments.reason: God is his light, and he illuminates from within, because God's light has clothed itself in him. This is the direct manifestation of divine light — the 'אור ה'' component of Package A. The node describes the state where truth and divine light have become one in the person. Quintessentially the truth/divine-light domain.

assignments.node_id: אמת, על ידי שירגיל עצמו לדבר בתפלתו הדבור באמת כפי מה שהוא
assignments.node_text: הָאֱמֶת, עַל יְדֵי שֶׁיַּרְגִּיל עַצְמוֹ לְדַבֵּר בִּתְפִלָּתוֹ הַדִּבּוּר בֶּאֱמֶת כְּפִי מַה שֶּׁהוּא
assignments.reason: Truth — by habituating oneself to speak truthfully in prayer according to one's actual level. The node begins with 'האמת' and its essential nature is truth-practice. Prayer is the context; truth is the substance. The emphasis on 'כפי מה שהוא' (as he truly is) reinforces that the essential quality is authenticity/truth, not prayer technique.

assignments.node_id: לראות הפתחים שיש שם, ולעלות משם על ידם
assignments.node_text: לִרְאוֹת הַפְּתָחִים שֶׁיֵּשׁ שָׁם, וְלַעֲלוֹת מִשָּׁם עַל יָדָם
assignments.reason: To see the openings that exist there and to ascend through them. The פתחים (openings) are what divine light reveals — they are the structural consequence of truth's illumination. In the Torah's argument, seeing the openings is impossible without truth/light (line 42-43: 'אי אפשר לזכות לראות הפתחים... כי אם על ידי האמת'). The essential nature of this node is the liberation that truth produces — it belongs to the truth/light domain as the visible proof that divine illumination is present.

assignments.node_id: לילך בדרך אמת לפי מדרגתו, כי חותמו של הקדוש־ברוך־הוא אמת (שבת נה יומא סט), והוא יסוד הכל, כי אמת הוא ראש תוך סוף. וכיון שהוא במדרגת אמת
assignments.node_text: לֵיֵלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֱמֶת לְפִי מַדְרֵגָתוֹ, כִּי 'חוֹתָמוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא אֱמֶת' (שַׁבָּת נה יוֹמָא סט), וְהוּא יְסוֹד הַכֹּל, כִּי אֱמֶת הוּא רֹאשׁ תּוֹךְ סוֹף. וְכֵיוָן שֶׁהוּא בְּמַדְרֵגַת אֱמֶת
assignments.reason: Walking in the path of truth according to one's level — the seal of God is truth, it is the foundation of everything, truth is beginning-middle-end. This node is a dense statement of the essential nature of truth itself: it is God's seal (חותמו), the foundation (יסוד הכל), and it spans all of reality (ראש תוך סוף). This is the definitional core of Package A.

assignments.node_id: נתלבש בו אור השם יתברך בעצמו, אשר חותמו אמת, ואז נאמר עליו: "ה אורי וישעי" (תהלים כ"ז). וכיון שה אור לו, יוכל למצא פתחים הרבה לצאת מהחשך והגלות שהוא סגור שם
assignments.node_text: נִתְלַבֵּשׁ בּוֹ אוֹר הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּעַצְמוֹ, אֲשֶׁר חוֹתָמוֹ אֱמֶת, וְאָז נֶאֱמַר עָלָיו: "ה' אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי" (תהלים כ"ז). וְכֵיוָן שֶּׁה' אוֹר לוֹ, יוּכַל לִמְצֹא פְּתָחִים הַרְבֵּה לָצֵאת מֵהַחֹשֶׁךְ וְהַגָּלוּת שֶׁהוּא סָגוּר שָׁם
assignments.reason: God's light clothes him — whose seal is truth — and then it is said of him 'God is my light and my salvation', and since God is his light he can find many openings to exit the darkness and exile. This node unifies all three elements of Package A: truth (חותמו אמת), divine light (אור ה'), and the verse 'ה' אורי וישעי' which the additions file identifies as the package's bechina pair with אמת. This is the fullest expression of Package A's domain.

assignments.node_id: להמשיך את עצמו תמיד אל האמת לאמתו
assignments.node_text: לְהַמְשִׁיךְ אֶת עַצְמוֹ תָּמִיד אֶל הָאֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ
assignments.reason: To draw oneself constantly toward the truth in its truest form. This is the active pursuit of truth — 'האמת לאמתו' echoes 'אמת האמתי' (the truest truth). Its essential nature is the striving toward truth, firmly in Package A's domain.

assignments.node_id: שיאיר לו השם יתברך בעצמו, ויראה הפתחים שיש שם, ויזכה לצאת מחשך לאור גדול
assignments.node_text: שֶׁיָּאִיר לוֹ הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּעַצְמוֹ, וְיִרְאֶה הַפְּתָחִים שֶׁיֵּשׁ שָׁם, וְיִזְכֶּה לָצֵאת מֵחֹשֶׁךְ לְאוֹר גָּדוֹל
assignments.reason: God Himself will illuminate him, he will see the openings, and he will merit to exit from darkness to great light. This is the culminating consequence of truth-practice: divine illumination, perception of the exits, and the great transition from darkness to light. 'אור גדול' (great light) is the final realization of the אור ה' that defines Package A.

package_A_אמת_ואור_ה.label: אֱמֶת וְאוֹר ה'
package_A_אמת_ואור_ה.note: All 12 cause/effect nodes belong to this proposed package by essential nature. The cause/effect edges in Torah #112 trace the Torah's central argument: truth (אמת) → divine light (אור ה') → seeing the openings (פתחים) → exiting darkness to light. Every node in these edges is an expression of truth, divine illumination, or the liberation that truth produces.

stats.summary: Torah #112 has 6 cause/effect (eitza) edges containing 12 unique nodes, none of which overlap with the 2 nodes in the existing bechina-based Package 1 (דרך, זווג). All 12 cause/effect nodes are assigned to proposed Package A (אמת ואור ה') from the gap analysis, as they all belong to the domain of truth and divine light — the Torah's central thematic axis. The cause/effect chain flows entirely within a single conceptual domain: practicing truth in speech/prayer causes divine illumination, which causes perception of the openings in the surrounding darkness, which causes liberation from exile to great light.
